schemas.acc_acceptance:
CREATE TABLE `acc_acceptance` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `project_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `project_task_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `execution_contract_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `acceptance_type` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `activity_status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `current_report_version_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `creator` varchar(64) DEFAULT '',
  `create_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `updater` varchar(64) DEFAULT '',
  `update_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `deliverable_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `origin_kind` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LEGACY_TASK',
  `origin_key` varchar(190) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `origin_snapshot` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `rule_snapshot` json DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_acc_acceptance_project_type` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`acceptance_type`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_acc_acceptance_task` (`tenant_id`,`project_task_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_acc_acceptance_origin` (`tenant_id`,`origin_key`),
  KEY `idx_acceptance_deliverable` (`tenant_id`,`deliverable_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_acc_acceptance_origin` CHECK ((((`origin_kind` = _utf8mb4'LEGACY_TASK') and (`project_task_id` is not null) and (`project_task_id` > 0) and (`execution_contract_id` is not null) and (`execution_contract_id` > 0)) or ((`origin_kind` = _utf8mb4'DIRECT') and (`project_task_id` is null) and (`execution_contract_id` is null) and (`deliverable_id` is null) and (`origin_key` is not null) and (`origin_snapshot` is not null) and (`rule_snapshot` is not null) and (json_type(`origin_snapshot`) = _utf8mb4'OBJECT') and (json_type(`rule_snapshot`) = _utf8mb4'OBJECT')))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_acc_acceptance_status` CHECK ((`activity_status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'COMPLETED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_acc_acceptance_type` CHECK ((`acceptance_type` in (_utf8mb4'PRELIMINARY',_utf8mb4'FINAL')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='初验/终验活动根'
schemas.acc_acceptance_record:
CREATE TABLE `acc_acceptance_record` (

  `acceptance_type` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PRELIMINARY' COMMENT '验收类型 PRELIMINARY 初验 / FINAL 终验',
  `acceptance_date` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '验收日期',
  `plan_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '关联交付计划编号',
  `applicant_user_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '申请人',
  `apply_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '申请时间',
  `approver_user_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '审批人',
  `approve_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '审批时间',
  `approve_opinion` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT '审批意见',
  `archive_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '归档时间',
  `status` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '0草稿 1待提交 2审批中 3已通过 4已驳回 5已归档',
  `remark` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '',
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_pms_acc_acceptance_code` (`project_id`,`code`),
  KEY `idx_pms_acc_acceptance_project` (`project_id`),
  KEY `idx_pms_acc_acceptance_status` (`project_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_pms_acc_acceptance_type` (`project_id`,`acceptance_type`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='初验/终验'

schemas.acc_acceptance_report_version:
CREATE TABLE `acc_acceptance_report_version` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `acceptance_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `report_version_no` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `report_status` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `acceptance_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,

  `previous_version_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `effective_from` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `effective_to` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,

  `uploader_user_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `upload_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `publisher_user_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `creator` varchar(64) DEFAULT '',
  `create_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),

  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `acceptance_rule_snapshot` json DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_acc_report_version` (`tenant_id`,`acceptance_id`,`report_version_no`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_acc_report_current` (`tenant_id`,`acceptance_id`,`current_marker`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_acc_report_dates` CHECK (((`effective_to` is null) or (`effective_to` >= `effective_from`))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_acc_report_status` CHECK ((`report_status` in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'EFFECTIVE',_utf8mb4'SUPERSEDED',_utf8mb4'REVOKED')))

  `product_desc` varchar(512) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '产品描述/物料描述',
  `allocated_qty` decimal(18,6) NOT NULL COMMENT '实施数量',
  `scope_status` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '实施范围状态',
  `allocation_version` bigint NOT NULL,
  `allocation_source` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '分配来源',
  `change_reason` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '变更原因',
  `department_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '办事处ID',
  `department_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '办事处编码',
  `department_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '办事处名称',
  `department_version` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '办事处版本',

  `effective_to` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '生效结束时间',
  `status` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ENABLED' COMMENT '状态',
  `version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '乐观锁版本',
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '创建人',
  `create_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '更新人',
  `update_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '更新时间',
  `deleted` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '删除标志：0否，1是',
  `allocation_confirmed` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'1' COMMENT '是否确认占用订单分配数量',
  `delivered_quantity` decimal(18,6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '项目范围原已发货数量',

  KEY `idx_scope_order_line` (`tenant_id`,`order_line_id`,`scope_status`,`project_id`),
  KEY `idx_scope_project` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`scope_status`,`order_line_id`),
  KEY `idx_scope_acceptance_lock` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`effective_to`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_scope_product` (`tenant_id`,`product_code`,`scope_status`,`project_id`),

schemas.cut_approval_instance:
CREATE TABLE `cut_approval_instance` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `task_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `project_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `plan_revision_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `plan_revision_no` int NOT NULL,
  `assessment_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `assessment_version` int NOT NULL,
  `checklist_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,

  `grade_code` varchar(8) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `initiator_user_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `initiator_project_scope_version` bigint NOT NULL,
  `source_snapshot_version` int NOT NULL,
  `source_snapshot` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '旧审批提交来源事实原件；新业务写入NULL，禁止更改历史原值',
  `route_snapshot` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '旧审批路由原件；新业务写入NULL，禁止更改历史原值',
  `lead_time_enabled_flag` bit(1) NOT NULL,
  `lead_time_snapshot` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '旧提前时间规则及计算事实原件；新业务写入NULL，禁止更改历史原值',
  `status_code` varchar(40) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `hold_reason_code` varchar(40) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_node_no` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `previous_approval_instance_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `replacement_approval_instance_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `decide_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `rejection_reason` varchar(1000) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `version` int NOT NULL,
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `create_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `update_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
  `source_task_version` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '提交时任务版本；历史原件缺失时可空，新业务按既有来源/提交规则必填',
  `source_plan_version` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '提交时方案并发版本；历史原件缺失时可空，新业务按既有来源/提交规则必填',
  `source_cutover_type_code` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '当时割接类型；历史原件缺失时可空，新业务按既有来源/提交规则必填',
  `source_network_mode_code` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '当时组网模式',
  `source_schedule_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '当时计划时间；历史原件缺失时可空，新业务按既有来源/提交规则必填',
  `lead_rule_version` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '提前时间规则版本',
  `lead_timezone_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '提前时间计算时区',
  `lead_plan_submit_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '方案提交时间',
  `lead_required_days` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '原规则所需自然日数',
  `lead_actual_natural_days` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '原实际自然日数',
  `lead_late_submission_flag` bit(1) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '原提前时间不足结论',
  `project_version` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源项目版本；历史原件缺失时可空，新业务按既有来源/提交规则必填',
  `project_code` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源项目编码；历史原件缺失时可空，新业务按既有来源/提交规则必填',
  `project_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源项目名称；历史原件缺失时可空，新业务按既有来源/提交规则必填',
  `customer_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源客户ID；原无客户时为空',
  `customer_code` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源客户编码',
  `customer_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源客户名称',
  `department_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源部门ID',
  `department_code` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源部门编码',
  `department_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源部门名称',
  `project_scope_version` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源项目范围版本；历史原件缺失时可空，新业务按既有来源/提交规则必填',
  `withdraw_user_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '任务负责人撤回身份',
  `withdraw_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '负责人撤回时间',
  `withdraw_reason` varchar(1000) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '负责人撤回原因',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_cut_approval_task_plan` (`tenant_id`,`task_id`,`plan_revision_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_cut_structured_owner_id` (`tenant_id`,`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_cut_approval_previous` (`tenant_id`,`previous_approval_instance_id`),
  KEY `idx_cut_approval_project_status` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`status_code`,`id`),
  KEY `fk_cut_approval_task` (`task_id`),
  KEY `fk_cut_approval_plan` (`plan_revision_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cut_approval_plan` FOREIGN KEY (`plan_revision_id`) REFERENCES `cut_plan_revision` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cut_approval_task` FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `cut_task` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cut_approval_checklist` CHECK (((0 <> coalesce(((`grade_code` in (_utf8mb4'A',_utf8mb4'B',_utf8mb4'C')) and (`checklist_id` > 0) and (`checklist_version` > 0)),false)) or (0 <> coalesce(((`grade_code` = _utf8mb4'D') and (`checklist_id` is null) and (`checklist_version` is null)),false)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cut_approval_decision` CHECK ((coalesce((((`status_code` = _utf8mb4'APPROVED') and (`decide_time` is not null) and (`rejection_reason` is null)) or ((`status_code` = _utf8mb4'REJECTED') and (`decide_time` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`rejection_reason`)) between 1 and 1000)) or ((`status_code` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'PAUSED_SOURCE_INVALIDATED',_utf8mb4'WITHDRAWN')) and (`decide_time` is null) and (`rejection_reason` is null))),false) = true)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cut_approval_grade` CHECK ((`grade_code` in (_utf8mb4'A',_utf8mb4'B',_utf8mb4'C',_utf8mb4'D'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cut_approval_hold` CHECK (((`hold_reason_code` is null) or ((`status_code` = _utf8mb4'PENDING') and (`hold_reason_code` in (_utf8mb4'ROUTE_CANDIDATE_NOT_UNIQUE',_utf8mb4'APPROVER_UNAVAILABLE'))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cut_approval_lead_time` CHECK (((((`lead_time_enabled_flag` = 0x00) and (`lead_rule_version` is null) and (`lead_timezone_id` is null) and (`lead_plan_submit_time` is null) and (`lead_required_days` is null) and (`lead_actual_natural_days` is null) and (`lead_late_submission_flag` is null)) or (0 <> coalesce(((`lead_time_enabled_flag` = 0x01) and (`grade_code` in (_utf8mb4'A',_utf8mb4'B')) and (`lead_rule_version` is not null) and (`lead_timezone_id` is not null) and (`lead_plan_submit_time` is not null) and (`lead_required_days` is not null) and (`lead_actual_natural_days` is not null) and (`lead_late_submission_flag` is not null) and (`source_schedule_time` is not null)),false))) = true)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cut_approval_replacement` CHECK ((((`previous_approval_instance_id` is null) or (`previous_approval_instance_id` > 0)) and ((`replacement_approval_instance_id` is null) or (`replacement_approval_instance_id` > 0)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cut_approval_status` CHECK ((`status_code` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'PAUSED_SOURCE_INVALIDATED',_utf8mb4'WITHDRAWN',_utf8mb4'APPROVED',_utf8mb4'REJECTED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cut_approval_values` CHECK (((`plan_revision_no` > 0) and (`assessment_version` > 0) and (`initiator_user_id` > 0) and (`initiator_project_scope_version` >= 0) and (`source_snapshot_version` > 0) and (`version` >= 0) and ((`current_node_no` is null) or (`current_node_no` > 0)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cut_approval_withdrawal` CHECK ((coalesce((((`status_code` = _utf8mb4'WITHDRAWN') and (`withdraw_user_id` > 0) and (`withdraw_time` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`withdraw_reason`)) between 1 and 1000)) or ((`status_code` <> _utf8mb4'WITHDRAWN') and (`withdraw_user_id` is null) and (`withdraw_time` is null) and (`withdraw_reason` is null))),false) = true))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='F-CUT-005 P5分级审批实例'
schemas.cut_approval_node:

schemas.imp_delivery_evidence:
CREATE TABLE `imp_delivery_evidence` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `project_id` bigint NOT NULL,

  `source_object_type` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

  `acc_retry_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `acc_last_event_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `acc_correlation_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `acc_accepted_record_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,

  `version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '',
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_imp_delivery_evidence_tenant_id` (`tenant_id`,`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_imp_delivery_evidence_source` (`tenant_id`,`source_requirement`,`source_object_type`,`source_object_id`),
  KEY `idx_imp_delivery_evidence_project` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`source_requirement`,`acc_sync_status`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_imp_delivery_evidence_retry` (`tenant_id`,`acc_sync_status`,`acc_next_retry_at`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_correlation` CHECK ((((`acc_sync_status` = _utf8mb4'NOT_PUBLISHED') and (`acc_correlation_id` is null)) or ((`acc_sync_status` <> _utf8mb4'NOT_PUBLISHED') and (`acc_correlation_id` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`acc_correlation_id`)) between 1 and 128) and (char_length(`acc_correlation_id`) = char_length(trim(`acc_correlation_id`)))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_retry_count` CHECK ((`acc_retry_count` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_revision` CHECK ((`current_revision_no` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_source` CHECK (((`source_requirement` = _utf8mb4'EXE-01') and (`source_object_type` = _utf8mb4'ARRIVAL_ACCEPTANCE'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_sync_status` CHECK ((`acc_sync_status` in (_utf8mb4'NOT_PUBLISHED',_utf8mb4'PUBLISHED_PENDING_ACC',_utf8mb4'ARCHIVE_PENDING_RETRY',_utf8mb4'ACCEPTED_PENDING_ARCHIVE',_utf8mb4'ARCHIVE_ACK_PENDING_RETRY',_utf8mb4'ARCHIVED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='EXE-01到货签收证据根及ACC同步投影'
schemas.imp_delivery_evidence_revision:
CREATE TABLE `imp_delivery_evidence_revision` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `evidence_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `revision_no` int NOT NULL,
  `file_artifact_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `file_reference_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `file_version_no` int NOT NULL,
  `file_scope_version` bigint NOT NULL,
  `file_fact_version` json NOT NULL,
  `file_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_record_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `source_version` bigint NOT NULL,
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  UNIQUE KEY `uk_imp_delivery_evidence_revision_id` (`tenant_id`,`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_imp_delivery_evidence_revision` (`tenant_id`,`evidence_id`,`revision_no`),
  KEY `idx_imp_delivery_evidence_file` (`tenant_id`,`file_reference_id`,`file_version_no`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_imp_delivery_evidence_revision_root` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `evidence_id`) REFERENCES `imp_delivery_evidence` (`tenant_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_file_artifact` CHECK ((`file_artifact_id` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_file_fact_version` CHECK (((json_type(`file_fact_version`) = _utf8mb4'OBJECT') and (json_length(`file_fact_version`) = 3) and (json_type(json_extract(`file_fact_version`,_utf8mb4'$.artifactVersion')) in (_utf8mb4'INTEGER',_utf8mb4'UNSIGNED INTEGER')) and (json_type(json_extract(`file_fact_version`,_utf8mb4'$.referenceVersion')) in (_utf8mb4'INTEGER',_utf8mb4'UNSIGNED INTEGER')) and (json_type(json_extract(`file_fact_version`,_utf8mb4'$.availabilityVersion')) in (_utf8mb4'INTEGER',_utf8mb4'UNSIGNED INTEGER')) and (cast(json_unquote(json_extract(`file_fact_version`,_utf8mb4'$.artifactVersion')) as signed) >= 0) and (cast(json_unquote(json_extract(`file_fact_version`,_utf8mb4'$.referenceVersion')) as signed) >= 0) and (cast(json_unquote(json_extract(`file_fact_version`,_utf8mb4'$.availabilityVersion')) as signed) >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_file_scope` CHECK ((`file_scope_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_file_version` CHECK ((`file_version_no` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_revision_no` CHECK ((`revision_no` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_imp_delivery_evidence_source_version` CHECK ((`source_version` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='EXE-01到货签收不可变证据修订'

schemas.imp_eng_installation:

schemas.plt_delivery_requirement:
CREATE TABLE `plt_delivery_requirement` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',

  `requirement_kind` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CATALOG' COMMENT '要求来源 CATALOG=能力配置生成 / TEMPLATE_FROZEN=模板冻结应交根',

  `minimum_quantity` int NOT NULL COMMENT '最低数量',
  `counting_unit` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '计数单位 MATERIAL/FILE_VERSION/SUBMISSION',
  `status` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN' COMMENT '状态 OPEN/SATISFIED/CONFIRMED',
  `confirmed_by` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '确认人（仅 CONFIRMED 有效）',
  `confirmed_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '确认时间（仅 CONFIRMED 有效）',
  `config_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '生成本要求的能力配置主键',
  `config_version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '生成本要求的配置版本',
  `version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '乐观锁版本',
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '租户',
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '创建者',
  `create_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '更新者',
  `update_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '更新时间',
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0' COMMENT '逻辑删除',

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

  KEY `idx_plt_delivery_req_entity` (`tenant_id`,`owner_module`,`entity_type`,`entity_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='交付-要求实例'
schemas.plt_delivery_submission:
CREATE TABLE `plt_delivery_submission` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
  `requirement_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '要求实例ID',
  `request_key` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '提交幂等键',
  `material_ids_json` varchar(1024) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '本次提交的材料ID清单（JSON 数组）',
  `source_type` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UPLOAD' COMMENT '提交来源 UPLOAD/BUSINESS_RESULT/BUSINESS_DOCUMENT/AUTO_PROJECTION',
  `project_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '项目上下文',
  `request_payload_json` varchar(2048) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '请求快照（幂等重放比对）',
  `decision_evidence_json` varchar(2048) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '判定证据快照（满足/原因/证据）',
  `status` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CURRENT' COMMENT '状态 CURRENT/SUPERSEDED/WITHDRAWN',
  `submit_evidence_json` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT '提交证据快照（文件版本与摘要）',
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '租户',
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '创建者',
  `create_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '更新者',
  `update_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '更新时间',
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0' COMMENT '逻辑删除',
  `current_marker` bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` = _utf8mb4'CURRENT') then `requirement_id` else NULL end)) STORED COMMENT '当前提交标记（CURRENT 时=requirement_id，其余为 NULL）',
  `archive_status` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `archive_failure_code` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `archive_retry_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_plt_delivery_sub_request` (`tenant_id`,`requirement_id`,`request_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_plt_delivery_sub_current` (`tenant_id`,`current_marker`),
  KEY `idx_plt_delivery_sub_req` (`tenant_id`,`requirement_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_delivery_submission_archive` (`tenant_id`,`archive_status`,`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='交付-提交台账'

schemas.plt_external_key_mapping:
CREATE TABLE `plt_external_key_mapping` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '主键ID',
  `batch_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '批次ID',
  `source_record_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `result_type` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_context` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_object_type` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_table` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '目标表',
  `target_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '目标ID',
  `target_role` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '业务角色',
  `target_sequence` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '目标顺序',
  `result_key` varchar(96) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`result_type` = _utf8mb4'RETAINED') then _utf8mb4'RETAINED' else concat(`target_role`,_utf8mb4':',`target_sequence`) end)) STORED,
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '创建人',
  `create_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '更新人',
  `update_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '更新时间',
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '租户ID',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_plt_external_mapping_result` (`tenant_id`,`source_record_id`,`result_key`),
  KEY `idx_plt_external_mapping_batch` (`tenant_id`,`batch_id`,`source_record_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_plt_external_mapping_union` CHECK ((((`result_type` = _utf8mb4'MAPPED') and (`target_context` is not null) and (`target_object_type` is not null) and (`target_table` is not null) and (`target_id` > 0) and (`target_role` is not null) and (`target_sequence` >= 0)) or ((`result_type` = _utf8mb4'RETAINED') and (`target_context` is null) and (`target_object_type` is null) and (`target_table` is null) and (`target_id` is null) and (`target_role` is null) and (`target_sequence` is null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='PLT迁移外部键映射或留存分类'

  `batch_status` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_count` bigint NOT NULL,
  `mapped_count` bigint NOT NULL,
  `issue_count` bigint NOT NULL,
  `retained_count` bigint NOT NULL,
  `failure_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `rule_version` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `version` int NOT NULL,

  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL,

  UNIQUE KEY `uk_plt_migration_batch_identity` (`tenant_id`,`owner_context_code`,`purpose_code`,`release_id`,`source_system`,`source_table`),
  KEY `idx_plt_migration_batch_claim` (`tenant_id`,`owner_context_code`,`purpose_code`,`batch_status`,`create_time`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_plt_migration_batch_counts` CHECK (((`expected_row_count` >= 0) and (`source_count` >= 0) and (`mapped_count` >= 0) and (`issue_count` >= 0) and (`retained_count` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_plt_migration_batch_failure` CHECK ((((`batch_status` = _utf8mb4'FAILED') and (`failure_code` in (_utf8mb4'MANIFEST_STRUCTURE_INVALID',_utf8mb4'MANIFEST_ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH',_utf8mb4'MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH',_utf8mb4'MANIFEST_CONTENT_SHA256_MISMATCH',_utf8mb4'SOURCE_PAYLOAD_INVALID',_utf8mb4'SOURCE_RECORD_CONFLICT'))) or ((`batch_status` <> _utf8mb4'FAILED') and (`failure_code` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_plt_migration_batch_final_counts` CHECK ((((`batch_status` = _utf8mb4'COMPLETED') and (`source_count` = ((`mapped_count` + `issue_count`) + `retained_count`)) and (`rule_version` is not null)) or ((`batch_status` <> _utf8mb4'COMPLETED') and (`mapped_count` = 0) and (`issue_count` = 0) and (`retained_count` = 0) and (`rule_version` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_plt_migration_batch_status` CHECK ((`batch_status` in (_utf8mb4'IMPORTING',_utf8mb4'STAGED_READY',_utf8mb4'RECONCILING',_utf8mb4'COMPLETED',_utf8mb4'FAILED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_plt_migration_batch_version` CHECK ((`version` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='PLT迁移证据批次'

  `payload` json NOT NULL,
  `published_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `disabled_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

schemas.proj_project:
CREATE TABLE `proj_project` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '项目主档编号',
  `project_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '项目编码',
  `code_root_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '创建时命名空间根项目ID',
  `project_sequence` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '永久流水号：0表示独立命名空间',
  `code_rule_version` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'V1' COMMENT '项目编码生成规则版本',
  `project_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '项目名称',
  `parent_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '父记录ID',
  `root_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '项目树根节点项目ID',
  `tree_path` varchar(1024) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '项目祖先路径缓存',
  `tree_depth` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '节点层级深度缓存：根节点为0',
  `tree_sort` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '排序值',
  `business_level_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '业务层级标签编码（与结构层级 tree_depth 分离；字典 pms_project_business_level）',
  `business_level_name` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '业务层级标签名称（拆分/移动时可指定）',
  `customer_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '直接客户主档ID',
  `customer_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客户编码',
  `customer_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客户名称',
  `manager_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主负责人用户ID',
  `manager_employee_no` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '负责人工号',
  `manager_name` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '负责人姓名',
  `company_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主责公司ID',
  `company_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '公司编码',
  `company_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '公司名称',
  `department_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主责部门ID',
  `department_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '部门编码',
  `department_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '部门名称',
  `project_type` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'STANDARD' COMMENT '项目类型编码',
  `signing_method` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '签约方式（字典 pms_signing_method；SDS 08 四维分列，前向扩列）',
  `project_category` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '项目分类',
  `implementation_mode` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '实施模式编码',
  `major_project_level` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '重大项目级别',
  `market_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '市场部编码',
  `market_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '市场部名称',
  `system_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '系统部编码',
  `system_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '系统部名称',
  `expend_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '拓展部编码',
  `expend_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '拓展部名称',
  `industry_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '行业编码',
  `industry_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '行业名称',
  `customer_project_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客户项目名称',
  `sales_type` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '销售类型编码',
  `business_type` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '业务类型编码',
  `service_level_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '服务级别编码',
  `not_track_reason` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '不跟踪原因',
  `contract_no` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '手工登记合同号（正式商业关系随 INT-02 接管；前向扩列）',
  `implementation_location` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '实施地点（多地点拆分属 PM-02；前向扩列）',
  `location_resolution_status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNRESOLVED' COMMENT '地点解析状态：RESOLVED/UNRESOLVED',
  `creation_reason` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '手工创建原因（BR-2 必填，应用层校验；前向扩列）',
  `lifecycle_template_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '生命周期模板ID',
  `lifecycle_template_revision_no` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '冻结的模板版本号（创建时快照；前向扩列）',
  `lifecycle_template_revision_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建时冻结的生命周期模板修订ID；仅来源追溯/冻结身份，不作为运行时设计态反查入口',
  `template_load_method` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '模板加载方式：AUTO_DEFAULT唯一默认命中/MANUAL_SELECTED人工选择（前向扩列）',
  `process_definition_key` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '冻结的流程定义引用（取自绑定版本，创建时快照；前向扩列）',
  `process_definition_version` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '冻结的流程定义版本引用（前向扩列）',
  `project_start_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '项目开始时间',
  `project_refresh_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '项目刷新时间',
  `project_close_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '项目关闭时间',
  `source_type` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MANUAL' COMMENT '项目创建来源类型',
  `status` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '状态',
  `progress` decimal(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '项目进度百分比（来源属 PM-11 阶段推进/任务闭环，本 Feature 仅消费做汇总）',
  `aggregation_weight` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '相对直接父项目的权重（NULL=等权，读时按直接子项目数归一化）',
  `weight_source` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '权重来源：DEFAULT_EQUAL 默认等权 / MANUAL 人工设置',
  `version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '乐观锁版本',
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建人',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '更新人',
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0' COMMENT '删除标志：0否，1是',
  `deleted_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '租户ID',
  `lifecycle_status` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '生命周期：ACTIVE/NORMAL_CLOSED/EXCEPTION_CLOSED',
  `current_stage` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '当前阶段：S0～S6',
  `assignment_status` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主责指派状态：UNASSIGNED/ASSIGNED',
  `task_tree_version` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '项目内任务树结构版本水位',
  `task_progress_version` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '项目内任务进度事实版本水位',
  `project_end_date` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '工勘提供的项目结束日期，工期倒排截止日期',
  `closure_policy_snapshot` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Explicit closure policy frozen from published template',
  `closure_type` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `closed_from_stage` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `closed_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_plan_version_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `custom_info` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `order_create_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `disabled` bit(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `effective_from` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `effective_to` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_proj_project_code` (`tenant_id`,`project_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_proj_project_code_sequence` (`tenant_id`,`code_root_id`,`project_sequence`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_proj_project_tenant_row` (`tenant_id`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_proj_project_parent` (`tenant_id`,`parent_id`,`tree_sort`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_proj_project_path` (`tenant_id`,`root_id`,`tree_path`(191)),
  KEY `idx_proj_project_manager` (`tenant_id`,`manager_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_proj_project_customer` (`tenant_id`,`customer_code`,`status`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_proj_project_company_department` (`tenant_id`,`company_code`,`department_code`,`status`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_project_lifecycle_template_revision` (`tenant_id`,`lifecycle_template_revision_id`),
  KEY `idx_project_active_plan` (`tenant_id`,`active_plan_version_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='项目主档及非固定层级项目树（双重唯一：编码租户内唯一/序号命名空间根内唯一）'
schemas.proj_project_code_sequence:

schemas.proj_project_company_department_relation:
CREATE TABLE `proj_project_company_department_relation` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键ID',
  `project_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '项目ID',
  `company_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '平台公司主档ID',
  `company_code` varchar(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '公司编码',
  `company_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '公司名称',
  `department_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '部门ID',
  `department_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '部门编码',
  `department_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '部门名称',
  `relation_role` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '业务角色',
  `is_primary` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '同一业务范围内是否为主记录：0否，1是',
  `effective_from` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '生效开始时间',
  `effective_to` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '生效结束时间',
  `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' COMMENT '状态',
  `primary_project_id` bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`deleted` = 0x00) and (`effective_to` is null) and (`is_primary` = 1)) then `project_id` else NULL end)) STORED COMMENT '当前有效主记录指向的项目ID（参与唯一键）',
  `version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '乐观锁版本',
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建人',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '更新人',
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0' COMMENT '删除标志：0否，1是',
  `deleted_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '租户ID',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_proj_company_department_rel` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`company_code`,`department_code`,`relation_role`,`effective_from`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_proj_primary_company_department` (`tenant_id`,`primary_project_id`,`relation_role`),
  KEY `idx_proj_company_reverse` (`tenant_id`,`company_code`,`relation_role`,`status`,`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_proj_company_department_dates` CHECK (((`effective_to` is null) or (`effective_from` is null) or (`effective_to` >= `effective_from`))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_proj_company_department_pair` CHECK (((`department_id` is null) or (`department_code` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_proj_company_department_primary` CHECK ((`is_primary` in (0,1)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='项目业务角色下的公司与部门组合关系（每项目每角色至多一条当前有效主记录）'
schemas.proj_project_deliverable:

schemas.proj_project_exit_record:

  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '项目正常收尾退出记录编号',

  `project_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `application_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `snapshot_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `closure_type` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `project_version` int NOT NULL,
  `stage_instance_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `template_revision_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `scope_version` bigint NOT NULL,
  `gate_snapshot_ref` bigint NOT NULL,
  `source_context` varchar(32) NOT NULL,

  `after_lifecycle_status` varchar(32) NOT NULL,

  `after_project_version` int NOT NULL,
  `process_instance_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revalidation_evidence` json NOT NULL,

  `create_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),

  `update_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),

  CONSTRAINT `ck_per_stage` CHECK ((`closed_from_stage` in (_utf8mb4'S0',_utf8mb4'S1',_utf8mb4'S2',_utf8mb4'S3',_utf8mb4'S4',_utf8mb4'S5',_utf8mb4'S6'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_per_type` CHECK ((((`closure_type` in (_utf8mb4'NORMAL',_utf8mb4'NO_TRACKING')) and (`source_context` = _utf8mb4'ACC')) or ((`closure_type` = _utf8mb4'EXCEPTION') and (`source_context` = _utf8mb4'PROJ'))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
schemas.proj_project_gate:
CREATE TABLE `proj_project_gate` (

  `version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '乐观锁版本',
  `creator` varchar(64) DEFAULT '',

schemas.proj_project_stage_execution_contract:

schemas.proj_project_stage_snapshot:

schemas.proj_project_stage_transition:
CREATE TABLE `proj_project_stage_transition` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `project_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `template_revision_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `source_transition_key` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_transition_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `transition_code` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `transition_revision` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `from_stage_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `to_stage_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `priority` int NOT NULL,
  `is_default` bit(1) NOT NULL,
  `default_marker` tinyint GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`is_default` = 1) then 1 else NULL end)) STORED,
  `condition_rule_revision_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `condition_snapshot` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `graph_version` bigint NOT NULL,
  `creator` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updater` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  UNIQUE KEY `uk_pst_code` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`graph_version`,`transition_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_pst_edge` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`graph_version`,`source_transition_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_pst_default` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`graph_version`,`from_stage_id`,`default_marker`),

  KEY `idx_pst_out` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`graph_version`,`from_stage_id`,`priority`),

  CONSTRAINT `ck_pst_default_v2` CHECK (((`is_default` in (0,1)) and ((`is_default` = 0) or ((`condition_rule_revision_id` is null) and (`condition_snapshot` is null))))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pst_self` CHECK ((`from_stage_id` <> `to_stage_id`)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pst_versions` CHECK (((`transition_revision` > 0) and (`graph_version` > 0)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
schemas.proj_project_task:
CREATE TABLE `proj_project_task` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '任务实例ID',
  `project_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '项目ID',
  `task_code` varchar(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务码（实例化时冻结，项目内唯一）',
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务名称（快照）',
  `parent_task_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '父任务码（NULL=顶层）',
  `parent_task_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '当前直接父任务ID',
  `root_task_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '当前根任务ID',
  `tree_depth` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '结构深度，根任务为0',
  `business_level_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '业务层级编码，与结构深度无关',
  `milestone_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '关联里程碑实例ID',
  `plan_start_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '计划开始时间',
  `plan_end_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '计划结束时间',
  `actual_start_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '实际开始时间',
  `actual_end_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '实际结束时间',
  `progress` decimal(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '任务进度0～100',
  `state_machine_revision_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '创建时冻结的任务状态机版本ID',
  `stage_code` varchar(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '所属阶段码',
  `priority` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '2' COMMENT '优先级（快照）',
  `sort_order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '排序（快照）',
  `estimated_hours` decimal(6,1) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '预估工时（快照）',
  `satisfaction_timing` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '满意度适用时点（快照，由 ACC-02 消费）',
  `acc_satisfaction_template_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ACC满意度模板ID',
  `template_revision_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ACC模板修订ID',
  `template_version` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ACC模板版本',
  `satisfaction_rule_version` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '满意度规则版本',
  `satisfaction_threshold` decimal(7,2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '满意度达标阈值',
  `description` longtext COMMENT '任务说明，格式由description_format明确',
  `source_definition_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '冻结来源：模板任务定义ID（proj_project_template_task_definition）',
  `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_ASSIGN' COMMENT '任务实例状态（字典 pms_project_task_status，初始待分配）',
  `version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '乐观锁版本',
  `creator` varchar(64) DEFAULT '',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updater` varchar(64) DEFAULT '',
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
  `deleted_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `description_format` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PLAIN' COMMENT 'PLAIN保留旧纯文本；HTML为安全富文本',
  `active_task_code` varchar(64) GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`deleted` = 0) then `task_code` else NULL end)) VIRTUAL,
  `suggested_start_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '建议开始时间',
  `suggested_end_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '建议结束时间',
  `acceptance_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '验收时间，与实际结束时间独立',
  `required_task` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'1' COMMENT '任务必选标志，旧任务保持必选',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_proj_task_tenant_row` (`tenant_id`,`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_proj_task_tenant_project_row` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_proj_task` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`active_task_code`),
  KEY `idx_proj_task_parent` (`project_id`,`parent_task_code`),
  KEY `idx_proj_task_stage` (`project_id`,`stage_code`),
  KEY `idx_proj_task_direct_children` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`parent_task_id`,`sort_order`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_proj_task_root_depth` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`root_task_id`,`tree_depth`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_proj_task_business_level` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`business_level_code`,`sort_order`,`id`),
  KEY `fk_proj_task_state_revision` (`tenant_id`,`state_machine_revision_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_proj_task_parent` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `project_id`, `parent_task_id`) REFERENCES `proj_project_task` (`tenant_id`, `project_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_proj_task_root` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `project_id`, `root_task_id`) REFERENCES `proj_project_task` (`tenant_id`, `project_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_proj_task_state_revision` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `state_machine_revision_id`) REFERENCES `proj_task_state_machine_revision` (`tenant_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_proj_task_plan_time` CHECK (((`plan_end_time` is null) or (`plan_start_time` is null) or (`plan_end_time` >= `plan_start_time`))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_proj_task_progress` CHECK (((`progress` >= 0) and (`progress` <= 100)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='项目任务实例（初始待分配）'
schemas.proj_project_task_assignment:

schemas.proj_project_task_completion_evaluation:

schemas.proj_project_template_match_history:
CREATE TABLE `proj_project_template_match_history` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '匹配决策历史ID',
  `project_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '项目ID',
  `trigger_type` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'INITIAL_CREATE/SOURCE_CORRECTION/MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT',
  `record_purpose` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'CREATE_DECISION/IMPACT_EVALUATION',
  `input_origin` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'MANUAL/SOURCE',
  `snapshot_schema_version` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '四属性快照结构版本',
  `before_attribute_snapshot` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '变更前四属性快照；首次创建为空',
  `attribute_snapshot` json NOT NULL COMMENT '本次判定使用的四属性完整快照',
  `attribute_owner_snapshot` json NOT NULL COMMENT '四属性Owner快照',
  `source_owner` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源事实Owner',
  `source_system` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '来源系统；手工为MANUAL',
  `source_key` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源业务键',
  `source_event_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源事件ID',
  `source_version` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源版本',
  `source_occurred_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源发生时间',
  `source_value_digest` char(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源原值SHA-256',
  `mapping_version` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源映射版本',
  `matcher_version` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '模板匹配规则版本',
  `match_result` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'UNIQUE/NO_MATCH/MULTIPLE_MATCHES',
  `candidate_digest` char(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '排序后候选集合SHA-256',
  `decision_mode` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '首次创建AUTO_UNIQUE/EXPLICIT_SELECTION',
  `matched_template_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '唯一命中或显式选中模板ID',
  `matched_template_revision_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '唯一命中或显式选中模板修订ID',
  `frozen_template_revision_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '项目当前冻结模板修订ID',
  `impact_result` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'NOT_APPLICABLE/NO_IMPACT/CANDIDATE_CHANGED/NO_MATCH/MULTIPLE_MATCHES',
  `operator_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '认证用户或注册服务主体稳定ID',
  `change_reason` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '去除首尾空白后的创建或调整原因',
  `occurred_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '业务发生时间',
  `recorded_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '事实写入时间',
  `idempotency_key` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '命令幂等键',
  `request_digest` char(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '请求摘要',
  `operation_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '稳定业务操作ID',
  `trace_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '可选技术Trace关联',
  `audit_log_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '可选系统操作日志关联',
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '',
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `deleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_proj_template_match_history_operation` (`tenant_id`,`operation_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_proj_template_match_history_idempotency` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`idempotency_key`),
  KEY `idx_proj_template_match_history_project_time` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`occurred_at`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_proj_template_match_history_result` (`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`match_result`,`impact_result`,`occurred_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_proj_template_match_history_decision` CHECK (((`decision_mode` is null) or (`decision_mode` in (_utf8mb4'AUTO_UNIQUE',_utf8mb4'EXPLICIT_SELECTION')))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_proj_template_match_history_impact` CHECK ((`impact_result` in (_utf8mb4'NOT_APPLICABLE',_utf8mb4'NO_IMPACT',_utf8mb4'CANDIDATE_CHANGED',_utf8mb4'NO_MATCH',_utf8mb4'MULTIPLE_MATCHES'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_proj_template_match_history_matched` CHECK ((((`match_result` = _utf8mb4'UNIQUE') and (`matched_template_id` is not null) and (`matched_template_revision_id` is not null)) or ((`match_result` = _utf8mb4'MULTIPLE_MATCHES') and (`trigger_type` = _utf8mb4'INITIAL_CREATE') and (`decision_mode` = _utf8mb4'EXPLICIT_SELECTION') and (`matched_template_id` is not null) and (`matched_template_revision_id` is not null)) or ((`match_result` in (_utf8mb4'NO_MATCH',_utf8mb4'MULTIPLE_MATCHES')) and (`trigger_type` <> _utf8mb4'INITIAL_CREATE') and (`matched_template_id` is null) and (`matched_template_revision_id` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_proj_template_match_history_origin` CHECK ((`input_origin` in (_utf8mb4'MANUAL',_utf8mb4'SOURCE'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_proj_template_match_history_purpose` CHECK ((`record_purpose` in (_utf8mb4'CREATE_DECISION',_utf8mb4'IMPACT_EVALUATION'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_proj_template_match_history_result` CHECK ((`match_result` in (_utf8mb4'UNIQUE',_utf8mb4'NO_MATCH',_utf8mb4'MULTIPLE_MATCHES'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_proj_template_match_history_source` CHECK (((`trigger_type` <> _utf8mb4'SOURCE_CORRECTION') or ((`input_origin` = _utf8mb4'SOURCE') and (`source_owner` is not null) and (`source_key` is not null) and (`source_event_id` is not null) and (`source_version` is not null) and (`source_occurred_at` is not null) and (`source_value_digest` is not null) and (`mapping_version` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_proj_template_match_history_trigger` CHECK ((`trigger_type` in (_utf8mb4'INITIAL_CREATE',_utf8mb4'SOURCE_CORRECTION',_utf8mb4'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_proj_template_match_history_trigger_purpose` CHECK ((((`trigger_type` = _utf8mb4'INITIAL_CREATE') and (`record_purpose` = _utf8mb4'CREATE_DECISION') and (`before_attribute_snapshot` is null) and (`impact_result` = _utf8mb4'NOT_APPLICABLE') and (`decision_mode` is not null)) or ((`trigger_type` in (_utf8mb4'SOURCE_CORRECTION',_utf8mb4'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT')) and (`record_purpose` = _utf8mb4'IMPACT_EVALUATION') and (`before_attribute_snapshot` is not null) and (`decision_mode` is null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='PM-07模板匹配决策与影响评估永久历史（业务字段只插入不更新）'
